name: APIVervePhoneticEncoder
summary: Phonetic Encoder generates phonetic codes for words using Soundex and Metaphone algorithms.
description:
Phonetic Encoder generates phonetic codes for words using Soundex and Metaphone algorithms. These codes represent how words sound, enabling fuzzy matching of similar-sounding names.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Phonetic Encoder from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
